item.title: Version 1.9.0
item.description:
What’s new

New and improved

  • isolate Alpha builds and require approved Stable promotion (#131)
  • guide setup and refresh access across macOS (#133)
  • add opt-in Jev comparison

Fixes

  • dispatch Alpha reconciliation with the workflow token (#138)
  • run the iOS release preflight on the pristine tagged source (#140)
  • explain unavailable updates in local previews (#136)
  • distinguish skipped Tailnet transfers from deliveries (#132)
  • publish Alpha artifacts reliably
  • populate default beta localization
  • set TestFlight what-to-test text
  • keep TestFlight localization attributes valid
  • complete TestFlight app information
  • use default TestFlight build locale
  • sync TestFlight review contact
  • unblock Alpha TestFlight delivery and stop stale rebuilds (#168)
  • complete TestFlight info in the Alpha app's primary locale (#169)
  • point /alpha/download at the published Alpha DMG (#170)
  • stop hourly Alpha rebuilds while iOS awaits Apple review (#171)
  • decouple TestFlight/App Store delivery from Sparkle releases (#174)
  • batch Sparkle 2.10.0, GRDB 7.11.1, Sentry 9.29.2 and CI action updates (#175)

Performance

  • shrink universal macOS downloads without feature changes (#159)

Under the hood

  • update appcast for v1.8.2 [skip ci]
  • enable automatic Alpha delivery to Sparkle and TestFlight (#139)
  • add persistent local build runner [skip ci] (#134)
  • consolidate successful dependency updates

Other changes

  • Recover guarded dependency merging with an explicit activation gate (#143)

Full changelog: https://github.com/crmitchelmore/pasta/compare/77c041cf9e1cd151f466d37ae384ba70eea54d14...ad985e50d1d26470ad0f1a1931ee0cb664fd1e2f
